verdict.rationale: Superhuman Mail is a SaaS email product, so a public API reference is a fair question to ask, and the axis applies. The evidence pack documents no API reference and no runnable examples. Probes for OpenAPI and Swagger specs returned 404 at every candidate path. The documented MCP server lets AI assistants drive the inbox, but it is a different capability and is not an interactive API reference.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
